title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Building Discipline and Patience

questions.text: What does discipline in trading primarily involve according to the lesson?
options: Chasing fast-moving prices to capture quick gains
Waiting for price to come to your predefined zone rather than chasing a move already running
Trading based on news headlines without analysis
Increasing position size after a win
questions.explanation: Discipline means waiting for price to reach your predefined zone instead of chasing an already extended move.

questions.text: If a trade setup requires a stop loss of TT$500 on a TT$10,000 account, you should still take the trade because it offers high profit potential.
questions.explanation: Risking TT$500 exceeds the 2% rule (TT$200 max), so taking the trade would violate proper risk management and endanger capital.
